# Form Patterns Reference

## Time Slot Selection (Salon/Booking Landing Pages)

### Problem
Free-text "date/time" field has low conversion — users don't know available slots, type invalid formats, hesitate.

### Solution: Date Picker + Time Slot Buttons

```html
<!-- Date -->
<input type="date" id="date" name="date" required min="2026-07-09">

<!-- Time slots as clickable buttons -->
<div class="time-slots" id="timeSlots">
  <!-- Generated by JS: 09:00, 09:30, 10:00... 20:00 -->
</div>
<input type="hidden" id="selectedTime" name="time">
```

```javascript
// Generate 30-min slots 09:00–20:00
function generateTimeSlots() {
  const slots = [];
  for (let h = 9; h <= 20; h++) {
    slots.push(`${h.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:00`);
    if (h < 20) slots.push(`${h.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:30`);
  }
  return slots;
}

// Render with booked/unavailable states
function renderSlots(dateStr) {
  const booked = ['10:00', '14:30', '18:00']; // Fetch from API in real app
  const container = document.getElementById('timeSlots');
  container.innerHTML = '';
  
  generateTimeSlots().forEach(slot => {
    const btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.type = 'button';
    btn.className = 'time-slot' + (booked.includes(slot) ? ' unavailable' : '');
    btn.textContent = slot;
    btn.disabled = booked.includes(slot);
    if (!booked.includes(slot)) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.time-slot').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
        btn.classList.add('selected');
        document.getElementById('selectedTime').value = slot;
      });
    }
    container.appendChild(btn);
  });
}
```

### CSS (inline allowed per ReviewWorker budget)
```css
.time-slots { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-top: 8px; }
.time-slot { padding: 10px 16px; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #e0d0c8; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; font-size: 14px; }
.time-slot:hover:not(.unavailable) { border-color: #e8c9b5; background: rgba(232,201,181,0.1); }
.time-slot.selected { border-color: #e8c9b5; background: #e8c9b5; color: #2c1810; font-weight: 600; }
.time-slot.unavailable { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; text-decoration: line-through; }
```

### Variant: Pre-Filled Slot Cards → Click to Book

While the date-picker pattern above generates slots dynamically from JS, there's an alternative **"pre-filled slot cards"** pattern for fixed-schedule demos where available times are pre-known and shown as cards in a schedule section.

### Use Case
Salon wants to show concrete available slots (e.g., "11 липня (субота) 10:30") grouped by service category, and let users CLICK a time to pre-fill the booking form — service, date, time, and optionally location. User request: "при клике на время сразу бы в заявке проставлялась бы и услуга дата время сразу".

### HTML Structure
```html
<div class="slots-grid">
  <div class="slot-card">
    <h3 data-service="Стрижка жіноча">💇‍♀️ Стрижка, укладка, полірування</h3>
    <div class="slot-date">📅 11 липня (субота)</div>
    <div class="slot-times">
      <span class="slot-time">10:30</span>
      <span class="slot-time">16:00</span>
    </div>
    <div class="slot-date">📅 12 липня (неділя) — Княжий</div>
    <div class="slot-times">
      <span class="slot-time">10:00</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="slot-card">
    <h3 data-service="Фарбування волосся">🎨 Фарбування / Реконструкція</h3>
    <div class="slot-date">📅 12 липня (неділя) — Княжий</div>
    <div class="slot-times">
      <span class="slot-time">13:30</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

### JavaScript (event delegation — one listener for all slots)
```javascript
document.querySelector('.slots-grid')?.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  const el = e.target.closest('.slot-time');
  if (!el) return;

  // Extract service from data-service on parent h3
  const card = el.closest('.slot-card');
  const service = card?.querySelector('h3')?.dataset?.service || '';

  // Find nearest preceding .slot-date sibling
  let dateEl = el.parentElement?.previousElementSibling;
  while (dateEl && !dateEl.classList.contains('slot-date')) {
    dateEl = dateEl.previousElementSibling;
  }
  const dateTextRaw = dateEl ? dateEl.textContent.replace('📅 ','').trim() : '';
  // Strip salon suffix before matching dropdown (e.g. "12 липня (неділя) — Княжий" → "12 липня (неділя)")
  const dateText = dateTextRaw.replace(/\s*—\s*(Княжий|Ахматової)$/, '').trim();
  const time = el.textContent.trim();

  // Parse salon from RAW date text (with suffix) — NOT from cleaned dateText
  let salon = '';
  if (dateTextRaw.includes('— Княжий')) salon = 'Княжий Затон, 2/30';
  else if (dateTextRaw.includes('— Ахматової')) salon = 'Анни Ахматової, 30';

  // Fill form selects by matching option text (keep default fallback for empty matches)
  const svc = document.getElementById('service');
  if (svc) Array.from(svc.options).forEach(o => o.selected = o.text === service || (!service && !o.value));
  const sln = document.getElementById('salon');
  if (sln) Array.from(sln.options).forEach(o => o.selected = o.text === salon || (!salon && !o.value));

  // ⚠️ Use dedicated date/time selects, NOT comment textarea
  const dt = document.getElementById('date');
  if (dt) Array.from(dt.options).forEach(o => o.selected = o.text === dateText || (!dateText && !o.value));
  const tm = document.getElementById('time');
  if (tm) Array.from(tm.options).forEach(o => o.selected = o.text === time || (!time && !o.value));

  document.getElementById('booking')?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('name')?.focus(), 600);
});
```

### ⚠ Critical Pitfall: Comment vs Date/Time Selects
User WILL object if you put date/time into a textarea. They want **dedicated `<select>` elements**:

- User correction: *"форма записи менять не нужно было. верни как было. т е по клику выставлялись не в Коментар"*
- Clarification: *"я просил в форме записи оставить дату и время. и когда кликаешь по времени в Найближчі дати то дата и время подставляются в форму записи в выпадающем меню, а не в Коментар"*

**Do:** Add `<select id="date">` and `<select id="time">` to the form HTML, populate with JS, fill on slot click.
**Don't:** Write date/time into `#comment` textarea or any other free-text field.

### Additional Feature: Auto-Populated Date & Time Dropdowns
Form should have two new selects (Date + Time) between Salon and Comment:

```html
<div class="form-row">
  <div class="form-group">
    <label for="date">Дата</label>
    <select id="date">
      <option value="">Оберіть дату</option>
    </select>
  </div>
  <div class="form-group">
    <label for="time">Час</label>
    <select id="time">
      <option value="">Оберіть час</option>
    </select>
  </div>
</div>
```

Populate at page load (30 days ahead, skip Sundays; 30-min slots 09:00-20:30):

```javascript
(function initDateTimeDropdowns() {
  const months = ['','січня','лютого','березня','квітня','травня','червня',
                  'липня','серпня','вересня','жовтня','листопада','грудня'];
  const days = ['неділя','понеділок','вівторок','середа','четвер',
                "п'ятниця","субота"];
  const ds = document.getElementById('date');
  if (ds) {
    const today = new Date();
    for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
      const d = new Date(today);
      d.setDate(today.getDate() + i);
      if (d.getDay() === 0) continue; // Sunday skip — COMMENT OUT when slot data has Sundays
      const o = document.createElement('option');
      o.textContent = `${d.getDate()} ${months[d.getMonth()+1]} (${days[d.getDay()]})`;
      ds.appendChild(o);
    }
  }
  const ts = document.getElementById('time');
  if (ts) {
    for (let h = 9; h <= 20; h++)
      for (let m = 0; m < 60; m += 30) {
        if (h === 20 && m > 30) break;
        const o = document.createElement('option');
        o.textContent = `${String(h).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}`;
        ts.appendChild(o);
      }
  }
})();
```
```

### CSS
```css
.slot-time { cursor: pointer; }
.slot-time:hover { background: var(--terracotta); color: white; }
```

### Service-to-Card Mapping (data-service must match dropdown option text exactly)
| h3 heading | data-service |
|------------|-------------|
| 💇‍♀️ Стрижка, укладка, полірування | Стрижка жіноча |
| 🎨 Фарбування / Реконструкція | Фарбування волосся |
| 💅 Манікюр / Педикюр | Манікюр |
| ✨ Ламінування / Татуаж / Масаж / Макіяж | Ламінування |

### Date Text Format
- Without location: `📅 11 липня (субота)` → no salon selected
- With location: `📅 12 липня (неділя) — Княжий` → parse salon from "— Княжий"
- With location: `📅 12 липня (неділя) — Ахматової` → parse from "— Ахматової"

### ⚠ Critical Pitfalls (from real bugfix 2026-07-11)

#### 1. Sunday skip in date dropdown vs Sunday in slot data
The date generator skips Sundays (`if (d.getDay() === 0) continue;`). But if your slot DATA includes Sunday times (like "12 липня (неділя) — Княжий"), the dropdown CANNOT MATCH the date.
**Fix:** Only skip Sundays if you're sure no slot data has Sundays. When sharing a static demo with pre-written slots, include Sundays: `// if (day === 0) continue; // slot data has Sundays`.

#### 2. "-- Княжий" / "-- Ахматової" suffix blocks date dropdown matching
The slot date text `📅 12 липня (неділя) — Княжий` produces `dateText = "12 липня (неділя) — Княжий"`, but the dropdown option is just `"12 липня (неділя)"`. The strict `o.text === dateText` match FAILS.
**Fix:** Store the RAW text for salon detection, and produce a CLEAN version for dropdown matching:
```js
const dateTextRaw = dateEl ? dateEl.textContent.replace('📅 ', '').trim() : '';
const dateText = dateTextRaw.replace(/\s*—\s*(Княжий|Ахматової)$/, '').trim();
```
Then use `dateTextRaw` for salon extraction, `dateText` for dropdown matching.

#### 3. First slot without "-- Княжий" leaves salon empty
If the first date (e.g. `📅 11 липня (субота)`) lacks the salon suffix, `salon` stays `''` and the salon selector stays on default.
**Fix:** Add `"— Княжий"` or `"— Ахматової"` suffix to the first slot's date text so all entries are consistent. Or extract salon from the nearest sibling card.

#### 4. Default option fallback
When filling selects, the old code skipped default option handling (`o.selected = o.text === service` without `|| (!service && !o.value)`). This means when `service` is empty, **no option** is selected instead of the default (e.g. "Оберіть послугу").
**Fix:** Always include fallback: `o.selected = o.text === service || (!service && !o.value);`

### When to Use Which Pattern
| Pattern | When | Pros | Cons |
|---------|------|------|------|
| Date picker + generated slots | Real booking data, dynamic | Flexible, scalable | Needs API; complex for static demo |
| Pre-filled slot cards (this) | Fixed demo with known slots | Simple HTML, click→pre-fill, no API | Static; manual update per demo |

### Used In
- Fargo Salon redesign (`demos/fargo/index.html`, built 2026-07-11)

## Benefits (both variants)
- **Zero invalid input** — user can only pick valid slots
- **Shows availability** — booked slots visibly crossed out
- **Mobile-friendly** — large touch targets
- **Conversion lift** — removes friction of "what time works?"
- **ReviewWorker passes** — no inline styles over budget, proper form structure

### Used In
- GLAM Beauty Salon landing (`docs/index.html`, lines ~260-290)
- Ready to copy for any service-booking landing
